task_hash_start: <what task-hash.sh printed before round 1, or none>
task_hash_end: <what task-hash.sh printed before the final report, or none>
verdict: <verified, clean with unverified items, fixes not re-reviewed, open findings, or review failed>

rounds.fingerprint: <the four hashes of this round's fingerprint, separated by spaces, or none>
facts: <each line round-facts.sh printed for this round, unchanged, one string per line>

findings.decision: <fixed, not fixed, listed for the user, rejected, outside scope, disputed twice, or escalated>

checklist.state: <met, not met, fixed this round, or not verifiable>
